tech.assembly-line.name: Assembly Line
tech.assembly-line.text: During Reinforce, you may add 4 Ships instead of 3.

tech.rapid-advance.name: Rapid Advance
tech.rapid-advance.text: After MOVE INTO, you may convert 1 of your Ships in the active system into a Settlement. This is a direct conversion, not a SETTLE action.
tech.rapid-advance.rulesOverride: Use the almanac/direct-conversion wording; the printed card uses SETTLE.

tech.frontier-pioneer.name: Frontier Pioneer
tech.frontier-pioneer.text: Before SETTLE, add 1 Ship from your Reserve into the active system.

tech.genesis.name: Genesis
tech.genesis.text: Immediately when acquired, add 1 Settlement from your Reserve onto any empty planet on the board. If no planet is empty, there is no effect.

tech.population-explosion.name: Population Explosion
tech.population-explosion.text: After PRODUCE, do a free SETTLE action in the active system.

tech.soylent-green.name: Soylent Green
tech.soylent-green.text: During SETTLE, if all planets in the active system are full, you may replace opponents’ Settlements with your own. Removed Settlements become their owners’ Credits.

tech.planet-killer.name: Planet Killer
tech.planet-killer.text: Immediately, if the additional black-hole token is not on the board, you may place it over a non-home planet. Return its Settlements as Credits and block that planet.

tech.artificial-warp.name: Artificial Warp
tech.artificial-warp.text: Immediately, if the additional warp token is not on the board, you may place it in any face-up system.

tech.arcologies.name: Arcologies
tech.arcologies.text: You may SETTLE one extra space above a planet’s printed capacity. The extra space is shared across Arcologies owners. The planet is full at printed capacity or one above it.

tech.kessler-syndrome.name: Kessler Syndrome
tech.kessler-syndrome.text: Immediately, if the additional asteroid-belt token is not on the board, you may place it along an edge of a face-up system, keeping the board connected including warp links.

tech.planet-nine.name: Planet Nine
tech.planet-nine.text: Immediately, if the additional planet token is not on the board, you may place it in any face-up system.

tech.mercenaries.name: Mercenaries
tech.mercenaries.text: After MOVE INTO, convert up to 3 Credits into Ships in the active system.

tech.banking.name: Banking
tech.banking.text: Whenever you do an action, you may also Invest it.

tech.spice.name: Spice
tech.spice.text: After PRODUCE, do a free PRODUCE action in the active system. That bonus activates other applicable Techs but does not trigger Spice again.

tech.agility.name: Agility
tech.agility.text: Your Ships can move through asteroid belts.

tech.gravity-drive.name: Gravity Drive
tech.gravity-drive.text: During MOVE INTO, each of your Ships can carry an opponent Ship. A carried Ship may be destroyed instead of your own Ship when entering a black hole.

tech.foresight.name: Foresight
tech.foresight.text: You may always privately peek at the top 2 face-down Event cards.

tech.patents.name: Patents
tech.patents.text: Other players cannot acquire a Tech you already own.

tech.research-lab.name: Research Lab
tech.research-lab.text: You may buy Techs at half price, rounded down, or voluntarily pay full price.

tech.death-sun.name: Death Sun
tech.death-sun.text: During ATTACK, each Ship you sacrifice may remove 1 extra opposing Ship or Settlement.

tech.cloaking.name: Cloaking
tech.cloaking.text: Before ATTACK, add 1 Ship from your Reserve into the active system.

tech.strategic-stall.name: Strategic Stall
tech.strategic-stall.text: Once per round during PLAN, you may pass instead of placing an action token.

tech.filibuster.name: Filibuster
tech.filibuster.text: At the end of PLAN, in player order, you may move 1 of your action tokens to the top of its current stack.

tech.patrol.name: Patrol
tech.patrol.text: Opponents cannot ATTACK your Settlements until they have eliminated your Ships in that system.

tech.insurance.name: Insurance
tech.insurance.text: During ACTIONS, whenever you are skipped because none of your action tokens is on top of a stack, gain 1 Credit or 1 Ship in a system where you have a Settlement.

tech.eminent-domain.name: Eminent Domain
tech.eminent-domain.text: Before normal endgame scoring, you may do a free SETTLE action in your home system.

tech.disruptor.name: Disruptor
tech.disruptor.text: Immediately choose a system. Opponents cannot place action tokens there next round. Multiple buyers in the same round choose distinct systems in player order.

tech.sabotage.name: Sabotage
tech.sabotage.text: Choose an undiscounted value X and buy this Tech. Remove another player’s Tech worth up to X, returning its marker to Reserve. Cannot target Sabotage or be bought in the final round. Research Lab discounts payment without reducing destruction value.

tech.flexible-economy.name: Flexible Economy
tech.flexible-economy.text: You may always move Credits back to your Reserve.

tech.government-incentives.name: Government Incentives
tech.government-incentives.text: Before SETTLE, do a free MOVE INTO action in the active system.

event.cyber-attack.name: Cyber Attack
event.cyber-attack.text: During ACTIONS this round, players may resolve any player’s action token on top of a stack, placing it on their own board and acting or Investing as their own.

event.ceasefire.name: Ceasefire
event.ceasefire.text: This round, all players must Invest their ATTACK action.

event.communist-decree.name: Communist Decree
event.communist-decree.text: Immediately, all players return Credits to Reserve, then gain up to 3 Credits from Reserve.

event.ragnarok.name: Ragnarök
event.ragnarok.text: Immediately repeat the Event step: discard the Events, draw 2 more, and hold another auction. If the Event deck is empty, there is no effect.

event.stealth-invasion.name: Stealth Invasion
event.stealth-invasion.text: Immediately, the selecting player may add up to 3 Ships from Reserve into any face-up system or systems.

event.scrambler.name: Scrambler
event.scrambler.text: At the end of PLAN this round, the selecting player may turn one entire action-token stack upside down.

event.economic-boom.name: Economic Boom
event.economic-boom.text: This round, Investments receive 2 rockets instead of 1.

event.luddite-decree.name: Luddite Decree
event.luddite-decree.text: All Techs have no effect while this Event is active.

event.all-your-base.name: All Your Base
event.all-your-base.text: Immediately, the selecting player may do a free MOVE INTO action in a system of their choice.

event.technological-singularity.name: Technological Singularity
event.technological-singularity.text: Immediately add 4 more Techs to the display.

event.flexibility.name: Flexibility
event.flexibility.text: This round, the selecting player may perform any one of the four actions regardless of the action-board slot used.

event.multicultural-tension.name: Multicultural Tension
event.multicultural-tension.text: Immediately, the selecting player may add 1 Settlement from Reserve onto the home planet of the player to their left, if there is capacity.

event.consolidation.name: Consolidation
event.consolidation.text: Immediately, the selecting player may do a free SETTLE action in a system of their choice.

event.spacetime-rip.name: Spacetime Rip
event.spacetime-rip.text: This round, all systems are adjacent for the selecting player’s MOVE INTO actions.

event.politics.name: Politics
event.politics.text: Immediately, in player order, every player chooses an action they will not use this round and places an action token in that slot.

event.vorsprung.name: Vorsprung
event.vorsprung.text: Immediately, the selecting player may claim an available Tech of printed value up to 6 for free, using a Reserve rocket. Cannot claim Sabotage.

event.turtling.name: Turtling
event.turtling.text: Immediately, all players return Credits to Reserve, then add up to 3 Ships from Reserve into their home system.

event.gravitational-lensing.name: Gravitational Lensing
event.gravitational-lensing.text: This round, all players can MOVE INTO through asteroid belts and cannot use warps.

event.migration.name: Migration
event.migration.text: Immediately, the selecting player may redistribute all Settlements within one chosen system.

event.recession.name: Recession
event.recession.text: This round, all players must Invest their PRODUCE action.

event.hive-mind.name: Hive Mind
event.hive-mind.text: Immediately, the selecting player may produce 1 Ship from every planet across the board where they and another player both have Settlements.

event.ammo-shortage.name: Ammo Shortage
event.ammo-shortage.text: This round, each sacrificed attacking Ship destroys only 1 opponent Ship instead of 2.

event.famine.name: Famine
event.famine.text: Immediately, each player returns half their Settlements in their home system, rounded up, to Reserve, choosing which planets lose them.

event.el-mayarah.name: El Mayarah
event.el-mayarah.text: This round, the selecting player produces double from shared planets: 2 Ships/Credits, or 4 if full.

event.capital-injection.name: Capital Injection
event.capital-injection.text: Immediately, the selecting player may gain up to 10 Credits from Reserve.

event.galactic-summit.name: Galactic Summit
event.galactic-summit.text: Immediately, the selecting player chooses a non-home system. Move all Ships on the board to it.

event.black-cloud.name: Black Cloud
event.black-cloud.text: This round, only Settlements can be attacked, not Ships.

event.earth-first.name: Earth First
event.earth-first.text: This round, every player’s first PLAN token must be placed in their home system.

event.prophecy.name: Prophecy
event.prophecy.text: Immediately, the selecting player may add up to 3 available Explore tokens to empty planets in distinct systems, then reveal all Explore tokens on the board.

event.alliance.name: Alliance
event.alliance.text: Immediately, the selecting player chooses another player who cannot ATTACK them while this Event is active.

source.description: Embedded starfield background, masked to remove print crop marks.

notes: All centres/radii are derived from source PDF image bounding boxes, not inferred from the raster at runtime.
Suns are deliberately anchored at their printed positions, which differ from geometric hex centres.
Lem has TWO printed asteroid belts, at edges 0 and 3; the systems.csv transcription has been corrected to include both.
Le Guin has FOUR planets, capacities 2;2;1;1. The catalogue transcription has been corrected to exclude the central sun.
Card artwork remains the supplied original; semantic text applies designer clarifications, including Rapid Advance direct conversion and Spice non-recursion.
Cover extracted from rulebook page 1; the separately supplied inline PNG binary was not available in the execution workspace.
Source sheets include duplicated player aids; exactly two faces are extracted for one shared double-sided aid.

Settlement slot centres are measured from the printed PDF vector indicator circles. Each planet has exactly its printed capacity of slots, in top-to-bottom then left-to-right order, normalized to the whole tile image. Any Arcologies overflow needs a separate UI anchor.
The first-player marker uses the newer artwork on Cards page 33. Stage regions are normalized top-left rectangles padded around each printed icon; they are highlight guides, not gameplay hit regions.

Clarke, Lem and Adams base artwork omits only the printed black-hole image XObject. Overlay features.blackHole at fixedBlackHoles centres; the unchanged source radii describe the former printed image bounds, not the new circular token diameter.
Le Guin has no printed black hole. The hole on the same source sheet belongs to the separate Lem hex.

source.description: Embedded cover illustration; matching designer branding, includes by Charlie Fish credit.
Original rocket silhouette with Economy icons; exterior page labels excluded. Highlight regions are padded around the source icon bounds.
Left circular black-hole Explore token, including its original blue rim. The print sheet slightly compresses its height; normalized to a circular 192-pixel image.
